messages:
noah: Planning a config-only push at 04:15 UTC: reduce per-tenant max_weight 0.6->0.45, bump tinybatch_limit 6->10, extend request_timeout_ms 2000->3000. Low-risk but ops watch advised. @zira can you be on deck?

zira: I can watch 04:00-05:00 UTC. Please include batch_size_avg and p99 per-region in observability hooks.

noah: added hooks. Deploy plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m checks. dry-run in 5.

deploy-bot: Dry-run ok. PR#4488 staged. Canary plan created.

pat: small note: increasing request_timeout might hide downstream retries; add throttled_retries metric.

noah: good point, added throttled_retries to watchlist. launching canary now.

deploy-bot: Apply started run_id=20260501-01. Canary=5% targets=[us,eu].

zira: quick spike in p95 in eu right after apply but p99 flat. kv_cache_miss up ~10%.

pat: looks transient. hold for one interval.

deploy-bot: Canary advanced to 25%.

zira: at 25% p99_eu +22% vs baseline, abort threshold is 25%. still under. throttled_retries +0.12%.

noah: decision: pause progression and pin a problematic tenant bundle seen in logs (tenant: beta-tx) to previous config to avoid user impact. Approve?

pat: approve pin. safer than full rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary paused at 25%. Executing tenant pin: beta-tx -> config=20260320-stable. Exclusion applied.

zira: after pin p99_eu back to +5%. other regions stable.

noah: advance to 100% for non-excluded tenants. release-note draft: "config-only: reduced tenant max weight, increased tinybatch_limit, extended request timeout. beta-tx pinned during rollout; follow-up with SE required."

deploy-bot: Rollout complete for non-excluded tenants. run_id=20260501-01.

pat: creating issue to root-cause beta-tx interaction (issue #4489). tagging SEs.

noah: thanks team, logging release and closing thread. :white_check_mark:
